verdict.rationale: Forter's docs say it offers separate production and sandbox environments for development (forter-docs-4). The TEST site exists to verify an integration before it is deployed to production (forter-docs-13), which covers the core of testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: details on how to provision sandbox credentials and what data the sandbox uses, whether the MCP/agent tooling can target the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
